proposed.sourceName: Darul Ifta Birmingham — 'Is Vitamin D3 from Sheep Wool Halal?' (Maulana Muddasser Dhedhy)
proposed.paraphrase: A Hanafi ruling that vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol) extracted from sheep-wool lanolin is halal, because wool contains no blood and is pure (tahir) whether from a living or non-slaughtered animal, and lanolin is a byproduct of shearing a living sheep. (Standing fatwa, accessed 2026-07-01.)
